job.title: User & Community Operations
job.mission: Own the end-user experience from the user's perspective: proactively collect real feedback, identify what matters, and drive it to resolution.
responsibilities: Proactively collect user feedback from communities, interviews, surveys, tickets, and social media.

Build and maintain user communities and feedback channels; turn scattered signals into clear, actionable input for product and engineering; improve operations processes with pre-release evaluation and post-release follow-up.

Build the operations data system: define and measure whether the product helps more people in more scenarios; analyze user behavior and core problems to inform product decisions; collaborate on monitoring and alerting.
Coordinate product, engineering, and research resources; track progress and risks; drive problems to closed-loop resolution.
Write clear user-facing communication for releases and version changes.

traits: Reliable and responsible; drives work proactively, keeps others informed, and finishes what is started
Enjoys user and community work; willing to do detail-heavy but important work for the long term
Strong perception of users and products; spots real needs and key problems in fragmented information
Excellent Chinese communication; able to communicate in written English
skills: Familiarity with AI and Agent products; heavy user of AI products
preferred: AI industry or AI product operations experience
Agent, SQL, or Python used to improve work efficiency
Deep participation in technical or user communities
One pursuit taken to exceptional depth, even if unrelated to the role

education_bachelor_or_above.instructions: Does `resume.full_text` state that the candidate holds, or is on track to complete, a bachelor's degree or above, as required by `job.requirements.min_education`?

true.what: Resume states a bachelor's, master's, or higher degree, or an expected graduation with one

false.what: Resume states only associate degree, high school, or no degree information at all
false.not_for: Degree in progress at a level below bachelor, or unrelated certificates mistaken for degrees

written_english_evidence.instructions: Does `resume.full_text` provide concrete evidence of written English ability, as required by `job.requirements.traits[3]`?

true.what: States an English certification or shows English used as a working written language
examples: Maintained English documentation for international users

false.what: No evidence of written English anywhere in the resume
false.not_for: Merely listing 'English' as a skill with no supporting detail

ai_products_heavy_use.instructions: Does `resume.full_text` indicate the candidate is a heavy, habitual user of AI or Agent products, as required by `job.requirements.skills[3]`?

true.what: Describes routine, intensive use or building on AI/Agent products
examples: DeepSeek / ChatGPT / Claude 日常重度使用
Built personal agent workflows on Coze/Dify
调用 LLM API 完成自动化脚本
自费订阅多个 AI 产品

false.what: No AI product usage mentioned, or only passing, one-off mention
false.not_for: Having merely heard of these products, or using one app occasionally

efficiency_tools_in_work.instructions: Does `resume.full_text` show the candidate used SQL, Python, agents, or similar automation tools in real work, as preferred in `job.requirements.preferred[1]`?

true.what: Used such tools to accomplish actual work with a described outcome
examples: 用 SQL 提取并分析工单数据
Wrote Python scripts to batch-tag survey responses
用 Agent 自动化周报汇总

false.what: No mention of these tools, or mentioned only as a skill keyword with no usage
false.not_for: Coursework-only exposure with no application described

exceptional_pursuit.instructions: Does `resume.full_text` describe one pursuit the candidate took to exceptional depth or excellence, even if unrelated to this role, as noted in `job.requirements.preferred[4]`?

true.what: One sustained pursuit with unusual depth, scale, or recognized outcomes
examples: 独立维护一个 2 万订阅的技术 newsletter 三年
从零建立并运营一个 5000 人社区

false.what: Only routine competence spread across many areas
false.not_for: Listing many skills without depth in any; one-off participation

user_community_work_depth.instructions: Based on `resume.full_text` against `job.responsibilities[0]` and `job.responsibilities[1]`, how deep is the candidate's hands-on experience proactively working with users and communities?

No mention of users, customers, or communities
Occasionally answered tickets or supported events
User contact was a side duty, not owned
Owned a feedback channel or community program
Systematically collected and organized user feedback
Ran surveys or interviews themselves

Turned user signals into concrete product or process changes
Tracked issues to resolution across teams

data_and_metrics_ability.instructions: Based on `resume.full_text` against `job.responsibilities[2]`, how capable is the candidate at building data systems and analyzing user behavior?

signals: No metrics, analysis, or dashboards mentioned
Read dashboards or reports
Used metrics in routine reporting without defining them

Survey design and analysis

Co-defined metrics with analysts or PMs without owning the system

criteria.what: Owned the definition of a metric system end-to-end (not merely co-built it), or built monitoring or alerting pipelines

coordination_and_delivery.instructions: Based on `resume.full_text` against `job.responsibilities[3]` and `job.requirements.traits[0]`, how strong is the candidate's record of coordinating cross-team work and driving it to closed-loop resolution?

signals: Individual contributor with self-contained deliverables only
Contributed to projects involving other teams without owning coordination

criteria.what: Coordinated multiple teams on defined scopes
signals: Tracked progress and risks across teams
Organized regular syncs and follow-ups

criteria.what: Led cross-functional efforts end-to-end — personally owned the closure, not just attended or coordinated it
signals: Drove problems from discovery to shipped resolution
Managed risks and unblocked issues across product and engineering

signal_to_insight.instructions: Based on `resume.full_text` against `job.requirements.traits[2]`, how well does the candidate demonstrate spotting real needs and key problems from fragmented information?

signals: Work described as executing defined tasks only
Reported problems already surfaced by others
Combined scattered feedback into a root-cause finding
Identified a real need behind surface complaints
Their identification of a problem led to a shipped fix or product change
Found issues before users or leadership flagged them

dominant_background.instructions: Which background best describes where `resume.full_text` experience is concentrated? Used to route the candidate to the right reviewer.

user_or_community_ops.what: User operations, community management, customer success, or support
user_or_community_ops.not_for: Product feature planning or pure data analysis roles
examples: Community manager at a SaaS company

product_or_project_ops.what: Product operations, project management, or cross-team program coordination

data_or_analyst.what: Data analysis or business intelligence as the main role
data_or_analyst.not_for: Casual use of Excel in another role

engineering_or_research.what: Software engineering, ML, or research as the main role
engineering_or_research.not_for: Using AI products as an end user

other_or_unclassifiable.what: Student, fresh graduate with no clear background, or mixed profiles not dominated by any option
other_or_unclassifiable.not_for: Profiles that clearly fit one of the options above
